prompt: In many countries, the number of animals and plants is declining. Why do you think this is happening? How can this issue be solved? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your knowledge or experience.
essay:
In many countries, the populations of animals and plants are declining at an alarming rate. This essay will discuss the main causes of this problem and suggest several effective solutions to address it.

One essential factor contributing to this issue is human activity, particularly habitat destruction and illegal hunting. As cities continue to expand and forests are cleared for agriculture and infrastructure development, many animals lose their natural habitats and food sources. Without suitable living conditions, many species are unable to survive or reproduce, causing their populations to decline rapidly.  At the same time, illegal hunting has pushed numerous endangered species closer to extinction. Consequently, biodiversity is reduced, disrupting ecosystems and threatening the survival of both animals and plants. This not only affects wildlife but also has negative impacts on humans, as healthy ecosystems are essential for food production, clean water, and climate regulation. For example, according to the World Wildlife Fund (WWF), habitat destruction remains one of the leading causes of wildlife population decline worldwide.

To address this problem, both governments and individuals should take responsibility for protecting nature. Governments ought to enforce stricter laws against deforestation and illegal hunting, while also establishing more national parks and protected areas to conserve wildlife habitats. Furthermore, public awareness should be increased through environmental campaigns and educational programs, encouraging people to adopt environmentally friendly lifestyles and participate in conservation efforts. By working together, society can better preserve biodiversity and restore damaged ecosystem 

In conclusion, human activities become the primary reason for the decreasing diversity worldwide and ecosystem. To reverse this trend, stricter government policies and public awareness in environmental conservation are crucial. By taking immediate action, we can ensure a healthier and more sustainable planet for future generations.
